items.label: %mainMenu_open_2%
items.localizeNotes: Application main menu > Project > Open (opens the Home view, which lists local and shared projects and launches the resource download dialog). Hidden in Simple mode: Simple reaches resources through the model text, Bible text and commentary pickers instead, and opens an installed project from the titlebar project selector

items.label: %resources_getResources%
items.localizeNotes: Application main menu > Project > Get resources (opens the dialog that downloads and installs resources). Hidden in Simple mode, which reaches resources through its own pickers
